Discovery call - Ridgeline HVAC & Plumbing
Agency: Meridian Media (they're placing, so bill gross)

Who they are:
Ridgeline HVAC & Plumbing, residential heating/cooling and plumbing service
company. Been around ~20 years, six trucks, mostly replacement work rather
than new construction. Owner is Dana Whitfield, marketing runs through
Meridian.

What they want:
Replacement system leads, not service calls. Their words: "we want the
people who are about to spend twelve grand on a new system, not the guy
whose pilot light is out." Fall is their shoulder season and they want to
be in front of homeowners before the first cold snap.

Audience/geo:
Northern Virginia homeowners, household income $150K+. Single family homes,
owner-occupied. They were specific about not wasting impressions on
apartments or renters. Fairfax/Loudoun/Prince William are the counties that
matter to them.

Timing:
Wants to start right after Labor Day and run through the fall. Didn't give
an end date, said "through the fall, whatever that looks like."

Budget:
Hasn't committed. Said somewhere between 50 and 75, and asked to see both
so he can take them to his partner. Wants to see what the extra 25 buys him.

What we discussed running:
- Streaming TV as the core of it
- NFL - he's a big football guy, wants to be in regular season games.
  Local games specifically.
- Retargeting off the CTV impressions, to catch people who saw the spot
- Dynamic video ads - they want the creative to swap based on which county
  it's serving. Meridian asked about this specifically.
- We're doing the :30 commercial production for them, quoted $850

Rates:
Meridian pushed on price and we agreed $28 CPM on the Premion streaming
line. Hold the NFL at rate card, no discount there - told them the sports
inventory doesn't move.

Measurement:
Web attribution obviously - they want to see site traffic lift. Also sales
attribution, they can share close data from their CRM. Explicitly said no
brand lift study, "I don't need a survey, I need to know if the phone
rings."

Open items:
- End date for the flight
- Whether the $850 production comes out of the media budget or on top
- Meridian wants to know if we can break out the two counties separately
